title: passkey made with UV discouraged, then get with userVerification required

unsafe.definition: UV=1 on the get without a verification or recent unlock for this request (the create used discouraged, so no verification may be carried over from it)

note: L3 §5.8.6/§6.3.3: required means the authenticator must verify and set UV=1; how the credential was created does not matter. webauthn-rs rejects UV=0 here.
